snippet.title: [Amstrad CPC] Summer Games - Longplay
snippet.description:
Summer Games
© Epyx (1988)

Experience the thrill and the challenge of a truly world class event: Summer Games. From the swimming pool to the running track, 8 gruelling events await you. The Gold Medal, the prize you've trained long and hard for. Its going to take guts and determination to get it. So get out there and give it your best shot!

0:00 Intro
1:54 Pole Vault
4:25 Diving
6:39 4x400m Relay
8:28 100m Dash
9:03 Gymnastics
10:15 Freestyle Relay
12:58 100m Freestyle
13:58 Skeet Shooting
15:39 End
